title: 4 oz ramekins
text: 4 oz ramekins. Purchased these because I like to bake mini cakes for my grandsons (4 and 7)... they also mold rice krispy treats really well... You can bake eggs in them (just remember to oil the dish well with olive oil or butter)... they are obviously oven safe... micro safe and dishwasher safe.  They are small, as ramekins should be...I included some pics for clarity. They are relatively heavy for their size. They are bright white ceramic and they are perfect size for my use!  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful and I hope this has been helpful!
